findings: Whole adult body and supporting bed are visible in whole-body layers.
Skin, major muscles, skeleton, organs, lungs and diaphragm, cardiac anatomy, and major vessels are distinguishable in their intended layer views.
Physiological measurement overlay is readable; terminal frame shows accepted time20.00s,3breaths,23beats.
The long passive-anatomy scope text clips at the right screen edge in detail views. No functional result is inferred from a still frame.
limitations: No continuous playback or every-frame pixel review was performed.
These images cannot establish absence of tissue intersections or quantify pressure/flow causality.
scope: Human visual inspection of ten exact extracted frames; does not replace continuous playback or exact geometry audit.
